defaultContent.headline: Loved by teams that ship
defaultContent.subheadline: Hear what our customers say about working with us.

testimonials.quote: We launched our marketing site in two days instead of two months. The result looked better than anything we have ever shipped.
testimonials.name: Sarah Chen

testimonials.quote: The editor finally lets non-engineers iterate on the site without breaking the design system. It is a complete win.
testimonials.name: Marcus Adebayo

testimonials.quote: Performance is incredible. Our pages went from 3.5 seconds to under one second on mobile after the migration.
testimonials.name: Priya Patel

testimonials.quote: Honestly, I was skeptical. Then we shipped three campaigns in a single sprint. I am no longer skeptical.
testimonials.name: David Rivera

testimonials.quote: The built-in analytics tell us exactly what to fix next. No more guessing — we just iterate where the data points us.
testimonials.name: Emily Foster

testimonials.quote: It pays for itself in the first month. We canceled three other tools and our site improved.
testimonials.name: Jordan Kim
